It does not apply in the European Union, United Kingdom, or South Korea and licenses use only inside its Territory. access_boundary: This record represents the Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct weight release of June 2025 at Hugging Face commit 290ddb9a56ed23c2c83a1c8081533e58925df952 (last modified 2025-08-21). The Hunyuan-A13B-Pretrain base, the FP8 and GPTQ-Int4 quantized repackagings, later Tencent Hy generations, and any Tencent Cloud API listing remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 80B MoE checkpoint with the full custom license text and a Notice file beside the weights
Model card documents TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang serving with prebuilt Docker images and a 256K context recipe
tradeoffs: License excludes the European Union, United Kingdom, and South Korea and forbids using outputs to improve other AI models
Model card names no hosted endpoint for this exact release, and the default config caps context at 32K until edited
